params.name: workspace
params.description: Scope the returned list to a single workspace (ID, resource path, or name). Pass `sfc:workspace:sfcompute:public` to list sfc-provided public images. Without it, the returned list spans every workspace the caller has requisite permissions on (public images are not included — request them via the public workspace).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-200, default 50).

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Cursor for forward pagination (from a previous response's `cursor` field).
